name: Mid-century cut-paper title sequence

source.description: Genre convention: 1950s-60s graphic title sequences built from flat, hard-edged paper shapes moving to a jazz rhythm, where shapes turn into type. Since 2026-10-30 also informed by two inspected user-supplied references with Bauhaus-style primitive compositions.

technique: Flat geometric cut-outs pop and slide on beat; a shape grows to wipe the frame; type appears inside shapes.

decomposition.timing: Cut and pop on beats; 2-4 beats per card

licensing_notes: Technique only. No specific artwork, footage, characters or compositions from any source are copied.

provenance.observed: Circles, quarter circles and squares pop into a grid; a blue rectangle grows to become the next background.
Primary-colour circle, bar, square and triangle assemble into a poster composition with oversized type, which then shrinks to a badge.
